profile.name: 网络摄像机
profile.description: 网络摄像机是一种通过以太网或局域网输出视频流的成像设备，可用于实验过程远程观察、样品与装置状态监控、图像记录以及实时帧采集。
profile.description_en: An IP camera is an imaging device that streams video over Ethernet or a local network. In laboratories it is used for remote observation of experiments, monitoring samples and instruments, recording visual status, and acquiring live image frames.

registry.name: IP Camera Capture
registry.description: IP Camera Capture是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括使能、停止、启动、增益设置、设备连接。支持Signal, Slot, discover等操作。
